data: BrisT1D open processed release, separate Type 1 cohort
role_assignment: five shuffled cadence-stratified groups of four; final group reserved; remaining groups form four fixed development folds
issue_schedule: one issue per reconciled glucose observation at observation time plus ceil(CGM delay/native cadence)*native cadence
target: exact measured glucose at issue time plus horizon; never interpolate labels
maximum_current_age_minutes: native CGM cadence plus assumed CGM availability delay
missing_device_policy: exclude source rows without a nonempty device label before constructing features or labels
historical_fields: exact diabetes duration with missing indicator
historical_availability: questionnaire fields assumed available at baseline; not independently verified
clock_features: same source-clock sine/cosine in every arm; no real timezone asserted
fit_weights: equal total weight per patient; deterministic uniform within-patient training sample
model_selection: no sweep or fold-result-driven selection; compare fixed configurations; no deployment from this study
availability_interpretation: declared retrospective assumptions; recorded measurement/event timestamps do not establish prospective entry/upload availability
existing_cohorts: no CGMacros/RBG sensor files opened; existing models unchanged
